prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a side impact at intersection in Katy, Texas, and has wrist fracture. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1314; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather not give my name on a recording, if that's okay. You already have my claim file.
Q: That's fine. For the record, can you tell me where you were when the collision occurred?
A: I was driving through the intersection in Katy, Texas, heading east on the main road. The light was green for me.
Q: Had you been stopped at the light before proceeding?
A: No, I was already moving at about thirty-five miles per hour when I entered the intersection.
Q: What happened next?
A: A pickup coming from the cross street on my right ran the red light and hit the driver's side of my car. I didn't see it until it was right on me. I braked, but there was no time.
Q: Did you have any warning, such as a horn or a squeal of brakes from the other vehicle?
A: I heard a horn just before impact, maybe a second before. That's all I can say.
Q: After the collision, did you remain at the scene?
A: Yes. My airbags deployed and I was shaken up, but I got out and waited for the police.
Q: Were you injured at that time?
A: My left wrist hurt badly right away. I didn't think much of it until the next morning, when the swelling got worse. I went to urgent care and they sent me for X-rays. The doctor said it was fractured.
Q: Have you received any treatment since then?
A: Yes, I've had a cast put on, and I'm seeing an orthopedic specialist next week to discuss whether I need surgery.
Q: Is there anything you would like to add to your statement?
A: Only that I was following the rules of the road and the other driver was at fault.
Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
A: Thank you.
